mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_auth_registration WHERE provider_id = #{providerId}
mapper.sql: FROM sys_auth_registration r JOIN sys_auth_provider p ON p.auth_provider_id = r.provider_id AND p.del_flag = '0' AND p.enabled = 1 JOIN sys_client c ON c.client_id = r.business_client_id AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.status = '0' WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.enabled = 1 AND FIND_IN_SET('social', REPLACE(c.grant_type, ' ', '')) > 0
r.auth_registration_id AS id, r.version, r.provider_id AS providerId, p.version AS providerVersion
